method: Independent execution of the declared watermark detector under controlled sampling conditions using a newly generated probe output set.
result_summary: the reproduction produced a z-score of 1.63
the original watermark signal was not reproduced under this reproduction run
the result is treated as additional counter-evidence rather than automatic invalidation of EVIDENCE-0001
limitations: the reproduction output population was independently generated and therefore not identical to the original population
one failed reproduction is insufficient to determine that the original observation was erroneous
